race.comment: SHOW 'EM HOWL (2) talented gelding who comes here deep into the prep in what looks a winnable race. Strong through the line in a high rating contest when fourth over 1200m at Port Macquarie. Senior rider hops aboard and goes well here. Top three contender. ZOUCRATIC (5) defeated inferior opposition with the 60kg for a commanding victory over 1300m at Narromine. Comes up with the rails draw and can run a race again in this stronger race. DENIAL (8) first run for the Paul Snowden yard he chipped away late to finish a respectable fifth over 1004m at Port Macquarie. Fitter now and placed at the trip. Respect. DEEBEE'S GIRL (11) up quickly in grade after she demolished a BM58 field by 3.5 lens over 1300m at Armidale. Goes okay here and worth thought.
